title: FAITH: Factuality Alignment through Integrating Trustworthiness and Honestness
authors: Xiaoning Dong; Chengyan Wu; Yajie Wen; Yu Chen; Yun Xue; Jing Zhang; Wei Xu; Bolei Ma
why_relevant: FAITH is a post-training method for factuality alignment that integrates uncertainty estimation (consistency, semantic entropy) with a RAG module to rectify low-confidence responses, relevant to calibration/control and knowing when to trust internal vs external knowledge.
why_not_or_caveat: Focus is on factuality alignment via uncertainty-aware RL; RAG is auxiliary rather than the core robustness contribution.
